notes: Lab schedule. Explicitly not a job offer or cash bounty. evidenceClass/consideration are not paid agent jobs.

data.boundary: A listed item is not a job offer, purchase order, or promise of payment beyond its stated consideration.

bounties.title: Expose one seller-route repair
bounties.scope: Provide one public GET method-path pair whose buyability contract may be reviewed without credentials, payment, or a state-changing request.
acceptance: Operator confirms authority to submit the route
Public challenge or discovery surface is inspectable without credentials
A public-safe issue and resolution summary may be approved separately
bounties.consideration: First three eligible reviews are sponsored by the lab. No cash bounty and no purchase are implied.

bounties.title: Provide a contract-complete synthetic listing
bounties.scope: Draft a non-live listing with exact authority, route, price, recipient, output contract, expiry, and revocation fields.
acceptance: Every required field has an explicit source
bounties.consideration: Design contribution only until the market experiment leaves staged state.
